scope: Four new boards chosen after the first rule freeze, before any product output or engine probe for these boards. Book judgments are falsifiable human hypotheses. Related chess families, not a random sample or novice user study.

cases.source: 100 Endgame Patterns, personal reading PDF page 59, reserve tempi position3; diagram visually checked.
cases.human_task: The h-pawn can supply two separate waiting moves. Explain whether h4 spends a tempo needed for the king to enter and complete its detour, compared with h3.
falsifiers: If h4 preserves the same winning result against best defence, do not call it a lost win.
A passed-pawn or capture ledger alone does not explain the reserve-tempo difference.
The h3 book line is a hypothesis; inspect other king and pawn replies.

cases.source: John Doknjas, Opening Repertoire The Modern Benoni, PDF pages59-60 (printed58-59), Game7 variation12Nd2?!; successor12...Nb6 diagram visually checked.
cases.human_task: Nd2 supports e4 but withdraws the active f3 knight. Test whether ...Nb6 and the threat ...Nfxd5 make this natural defence inferior to Re1; explain the concrete enabled response and its cost.
falsifiers: Do not claim ...Nb6 forces material gain from one PV.
The queen on c2 and bishop on e2 must be tracked; an attack count is not a proof of an unanswerable threat.
If modern equal-depth analysis does not separate the alternatives, report the book hypothesis as unconfirmed.

cases.source: Catalan introductory fianchetto setup; new early position selected after the rule freeze.
cases.human_task: Explain completing the fianchetto and the bishop diagonal. Several sound development orders may exist; avoid inventing a defect to explain a small ranking difference.
falsifiers: If a concrete immediate threat or significant stable difference appears, the ordinary-purpose assumption must be revised in the reading.
Do not claim full equality from a short engine search or safety from the development label.

cases.source: John Doknjas, Opening Repertoire The Modern Benoni, Game6, printed page51 (PDF52), variation9e5?.
cases.human_task: The central break is premature if ...dxe5, fxe5 and ...Ng4/...Nxe5 win the pawn without enough return. Explain the actual reply and complete price rather than praising space alone.
falsifiers: Inspect White alternatives to fxe5 and Black alternatives to Ng4.
An initial pawn loss is not itself evidence of inadequate compensation.
Do not call the published line forced.
